- Artifacts: quickstart doc in Drive, Fireflies recorded 03/04 short demo session, Gmail thread with feedback on token costs.
- Risks: will swap to cheaper hosted alternatives if unit economics don't look good in first month.
- Good lead signal: engaged dev (built prototype), clear product fit, will likely convert to paid if we show predictable cost controls and a streaming example.
